map.空调耗电与电费估算使用指南：说明额定制冷功率、使用强度、待机功耗与电价的计算口径: Air Conditioner Energy Cost Calculator Guide: explains rated input power, usage intensity, standby power and electricity price, with hourly, daily, monthly and cooling-season cost examples, plus common questions about inverter units, peak/off-peak tariffs and energy-saving judgments.
map.空调耗电与电费估算按额定制冷功率、每日运行小时、使用天数、电价、使用强度与待机功: The calculator turns rated input power, daily run hours, days used, electricity price, usage intensity and standby power into hourly, daily, monthly and cooling-season energy use and cost, helping households with renovation choices, rental budgets and peak/off-peak tariff decisions.
map.平均输入功率 = 额定制冷功率 × 使用强度系数；日耗电 =（平均输入功率 ×: Average input power = rated input power × usage factor; daily energy = (average input power × daily run hours + standby power × standby hours) ÷ 1000; monthly cost = daily energy × days used × price; season cost = monthly cost × season months. Usage factors are 0.85 eco, 1.0 normal and 1.15 high load.
map.在空调铭牌或说明书中找到「制冷输入功率」，单位 W；不要填制冷量或电辅热功率。: Find cooling input power on the nameplate or manual in W; do not enter cooling capacity or electric auxiliary heat power.

Actual use depends on room size, insulation, orientation, outdoor temperature, setpoint and filter cleanliness; inverter units draw less at part load. For exact metering, use a meter or a socket with energy monitoring.
map.额定制冷功率和实际耗电为什么不一样？: Why does actual energy use differ from rated input power?
map.铭牌值是标准工况下的输入功率。室内外温差、设定温度、滤网清洁度、房间保温都会改变: The nameplate value is input power at standard conditions. Indoor-outdoor temperature difference, setpoint, filter cleanliness and insulation all change compressor load; inverter units draw much less at part load. This tool applies a usage factor as an approximation, for budgeting rather than precise metering.
map.变频空调应该怎么填使用强度？: What usage intensity should an inverter AC use?
map.长时间运行、房间保温正常时选「节能」或「标准」更接近实际；刚开机、西晒、顶层或设: For long runs with normal insulation, eco or normal is closer to reality; for startup, west-facing windows, top floors or a very low setpoint, choose high load. For a conservative estimate, use normal or high load.

map.电费单价怎么填更准确？: How can I enter a more accurate electricity price?
